products.name: Speechmatics
products.note: Speech-to-text; real-time translation; accent-agnostic; UK-hosted; GDPR

profile_text.body:
Speechmatics is a UK-based company that builds speech-to-text APIs intended, as the company describes it, for real conversations rather than clean demos. Its platform handles recorded files and live audio, returning transcripts for use cases including captions, search, analytics, meeting notes, and voice agents. The company emphasizes support for accents, multiple speakers, and natural language switching across more than 55 languages within a single model.

The core product is a speech-to-text and text-to-speech API with sub-second, speaker-aware processing, flexible integration options, and selectable models tuned for accuracy, multilingual performance, or lower latency and cost. Speechmatics also positions its technology for contact center applications, describing benefits such as reduced wait times and improved agent productivity. A multilingual model with code-switching across 55 or more languages was available in production preview at the time of the site harvest, beginning with batch transcription.

The held facts note that Speechmatics is UK-hosted and GDPR-relevant, consistent with the company's own emphasis on international market deployment. No litigation, SEC filings, or patent records appear in the available data.
